name: Data Preview Depricarping
implementation_notes: Dual-mode component (list/detail driven by :id? route param), mirrors DataPreviewPressingView.vue's watch()-driven mode switch exactly

Detail mode renders the Depricarping Detail grid read-only straight from stored columns (no recomputation, historical data), however many rows the record actually has (REVISED 2026-08-24: no longer always 24 -- this screen required NO functional code change for the entity-catalog v12 dynamic-add-row revision, since it already rendered `details.length` rows directly and already had an empty-state for zero rows) plus the same static 4-column Target Operasional reference table used by Form Depricarping (screen-043)
Checked By/Acknowledged By rendered read-only with no role restriction on viewing, consistent with Data Preview Threshing/Pressing and this screen's business spec

REVISI (tech-spec v3, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak, kode tidak diubah): mode detail memasang RecordVerificationActions (station-type='depricarping', local-table='depricarping_record') yang memanggil PATCH /api/records/depricarping/{server_id}/verification; backend RecordVerificationService::setVerification menerapkan peran + cakupan mill lalu assertPeriodOpenForWrite (EnforcesPeriodLock) atas `date` record sebelum menulis — periode stasiun tidak terbuka / tanggal di luar rentang → 422 PERIOD_CLOSED tanpa perubahan kolom; komponen menampilkan pesan server dan baris lokal tidak diperbarui (UPDATE lokal hanya setelah sukses); offline → pesan 'Butuh koneksi internet untuk verifikasi'. Tercakup oleh backend/tests/Feature/Api/RecordVerificationTest.php (blok 'kunci periode pada jalur verifikasi') dan backend/tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php; mobile/tests/recordVerification.spec.ts mencakup galat offline tetapi belum punya kasus PERIOD_CLOSED khusus.

REVISI v4 (2026-10-03, sinkronisasi catatan uji — kode tidak diubah): celah 'recordVerification.spec.ts belum punya kasus PERIOD_CLOSED khusus' pada catatan REVISI kunci periode di atas kini TERTUTUP — mobile/tests/recordVerification.spec.ts menambah 'shows the period-lock (422 PERIOD_CLOSED) message verbatim as an error and leaves the local row untouched' untuk komponen bersama RecordVerificationActions yang dipasang di mode detail layar ini: pesan server 422 PERIOD_CLOSED ditampilkan apa adanya sebagai galat dan baris lokal tidak di-UPDATE. Uji hijau.

REVISI (2026-10-03, run penuh Playwright mobile 430 lulus / 0 gagal): mobile/tests/e2e/data-preview-depricarping.spec.ts 4/4 lulus — kini dijalankan nyata (known_issue 'tidak dapat dijalankan di sandbox' dihapus). Perbaikan spec (drift, bukan cacat aplikasi): cek negatif not.toHaveURL pada 'Back dari Mode Detail' memakai glob '**/…' yang digabung ke baseURL sehingga tak pernah cocok — kini RegExp.

REVISI (2026-10-04, audit-fix — sinkronisasi artefak, kode adalah acuan): DataPreviewDepricarpingView.vue kini memanggil recordVerificationApi.pullVerificationStatus('depricarping', 'depricarping_record', userId) best-effort saat loadList() dan refreshVerificationInBackground() saat detail dibuka (memuat ulang via getDraftWithDetails bila status berubah) → GET /api/records/depricarping/verification?ids[]=… (baru: RecordVerificationStatusController/Service, routes/api.php, operator boleh, cakupan mill). PATCH verifikasi kini memakai prefix /api dan isNetworkError() memakai flag `network: true` dari apiClient. SyncFailureHint.vue ('Gagal sinkron: <alasan>' dari kolom lokal sync_error, ditulis/dikosongkan syncService) dipasang di item list (compact) dan di atas detail. Detail Tanggal kini FormField type=date lewat toDateInputValue (utils/localDate.ts; sebelumnya datetime-local). filter-row grid minmax(0,1fr) — tanpa geser horizontal di 390px. Uji: SyncFailureHint.spec.ts, syncService.sqljs.spec.ts (#6 pullVerificationStatus), recordVerification.spec.ts, e2e sync-and-verification.spec.ts (pola #2/#9/#6 yang sama di stasiun lain), backend MobileReadEndpointsTest.php.

Round 3 2026-10-05 (e4f231e filter, d5da9cf loading): DataPreviewDepricarpingView.vue memakai ListFilterBar (placeholder 'Presser ID', testid date-filter-input/search-filter-input, :filtered-count/:total-count/:show-count=!listLoading && !listError, :active=hasActiveFilter, @reset=onResetFilter); CSS filter lokal dan tombol Reset di kotak kosong dihapus.

status memuat diganti LoadingState (list-loading, detail-loading) + verificationRefreshing ref → LoadingState compact verification-refreshing.
